# Nibbables

> Long-lasting dog chews, compared by what each brand actually says. A directory of long-lasting dog chews (bully sticks, yak cheese chews, beef cheek rolls, rawhide-free chews and antlers) that quotes each brand's own product page.

Each product card quotes the brand's own page word for word (ingredients, made-in and sourcing wording, size guidance, supervision notes), links that page and shows the date it was checked. Made-in and sourcing statements are the brands' claims, not independently verified. Missing facts are marked "Not stated, check with them". Nibbables shows no prices, reviews, star ratings or safety ratings, and it is not veterinary advice. Some product cards have Amazon Associates and/or CJ Affiliate (Raw Paws) links; see the About page for the disclosure.

## Chew types

- [Bully sticks compared: ingredients, made-in claims & sizes](https://nibbables.com/bully-sticks/): Bully sticks from Campfire Treats, GREAT DOG, Best Bully Sticks, Redbarn, Jack&Pup, Mighty Paw and more, with ingredients, made-in claims and sizes quoted.
- [Yak cheese chews compared: ingredients & origin claims](https://nibbables.com/yak-cheese-chews/): Yak cheese dog chews from Mighty Paw, Pupford, Pawstruck, Raw Paws and Best Bully Sticks, with ingredients and origin claims quoted from each brand.
- [Beef cheek rolls compared: ingredients & country of origin](https://nibbables.com/beef-cheek-rolls/): Beef cheek roll dog chews from Redbarn, Raw Paws and Best Bully Sticks, with ingredients and country-of-origin claims quoted from each brand's page.
- [Rawhide-free dog chews: brands that state it, quoted](https://nibbables.com/rawhide-free/): Dog chews whose brand says they're rawhide-free or made without rawhide, including Earth Animal No-Hide, quoted from each brand's page.
- [Best antlers for dogs? Elk & deer chews compared by brand](https://nibbables.com/antlers/): Elk and deer antler chews from GREAT DOG, Redbarn, Mighty Paw, Nature Gnaws and Best Bully Sticks, with sourcing and size guidance quoted from each brand.
- [Collagen sticks compared: ingredients & origin claims](https://nibbables.com/collagen-sticks/): Beef collagen dog chews from Raw Paws Pet Food, Best Bully Sticks and Jack&Pup, with each brand's ingredient list, origin claims and sizes quoted from their…
- [Beef tendon dog chews: origin & ingredients by brand](https://nibbables.com/beef-tendons/): Beef tendon dog chews from Pawstruck, Redbarn, Pupford, Sancho & Lola's Closet and Nature Gnaws, with ingredients, origin claims and sizes quoted from each…
- [Gullet sticks & beef esophagus chews by brand | Nibbables](https://nibbables.com/esophagus-chews/): Gullet sticks, beef esophagus strips and weasand chews from 7 brands, with ingredients, origin claims and sizes quoted from each brand's own product page.

## Guides

- [Is a beef cheek roll rawhide? Brands and vets, quoted](https://nibbables.com/beef-cheek-roll-vs-rawhide/): Is a beef cheek roll rawhide? How veterinary sources define rawhide, what 3 beef cheek roll brands say theirs is made from, and what they leave unstated.
- [Bully stick calories: brand figures and a vet study](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-calories/): Bully stick calories per inch and per stick from a Canadian Veterinary Journal study, plus the calorie and per-day wording on 15 brand pages, quoted.
- [Bully stick vs beef cheek roll: what 3 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-beef-cheek/): Bully stick vs beef cheek roll from the same 3 brands: ingredients, origin, calories, shelf life and size, quoted from each page, plus what the AKC says.
- [Bully stick vs beef tendon: what 5 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-beef-tendon/): Bully sticks vs beef tendon chews from the same 5 brands: ingredients, origin, calories and shelf life quoted from each page, plus what the AKC says.
- [Bully stick vs bully hide chew: what Cadet and Rocky Ranch say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-bully-hide/): Bully hide chews vs bully sticks: ingredients and rawhide wording quoted from Cadet's and Rocky Ranch's own pages. Are Cadet bully sticks rawhide?
- [Bully stick vs collagen stick: what 3 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-collagen-stick/): Bully stick vs collagen stick from the same 3 brands: ingredients, origin, calories, protein and chewer wording quoted from each page, plus vet sources.
- [Bully stick vs gullet stick: what 7 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-gullet-stick/): Bully sticks vs gullet sticks (beef esophagus) from the same 7 brands: ingredients, origin, calories and chewer wording quoted from each brand's page.
- [Bully stick vs rawhide: what vets and 14 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-rawhide/): Bully sticks vs rawhide for dogs: how vet sources define each, and what 14 bully stick brands' pages say about rawhide, quoted. Are bully sticks rawhide?
- [Bully stick vs yak chew: ingredients, origin, calories](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-yak-chew/): Bully stick vs yak chew, side by side: ingredients, where made and calories as 14 brand pages state them, plus what the AKC and a vet journal say about each.
- [Bully sticks made in the USA: what 18 brand pages say](https://nibbables.com/bully-sticks-made-in-usa/): Which bully sticks say they're made or sourced in the USA? 18 brand pages quoted word for word, from made-and-sourced to packaged-only, plus the FTC rule.
- [Do bully sticks go bad? Shelf life and storage | Nibbables](https://nibbables.com/how-long-do-bully-sticks-last/): Bully stick shelf life, storage and when to take one away, quoted from 18 brand product pages plus Redbarn, Natural Farm and FDA guidance.
- [How long to microwave a Himalayan yak chew: 7 sources](https://nibbables.com/yak-chew-microwave/): Yak chew microwave instructions from Himalayan Dog Chew, Yak Chewz, Mighty Paw, Pawstruck, YAKERS, Yakkity Zac's and Whole Dog Journal: soak, time, cooling.
